material.acceptance_criteria: Pack built by scripts/assets/build-packs.mjs; index.json lists every placed prop kind with byte range; every indexed kind resolves to bytes in the pack; total size and cache key reported; kinds without a model listed with reasons; commit by lanmower with no Co-Authored-By; ci-status green on the pushed full sha.
material.description: Build a single props pack (model and texture bytes plus a byte-range index per prop kind) the same way as the character and item packs in scripts/assets/build-packs.mjs. Scope: every prop kind placed by the moba map, from scenarios/moba doodad-types-688g.tsv, doodad-types-w3.tsv, doodads-688g.tsv, doodads-w3.tsv and doodad-assets.tsv, with its model, texture and variation. Kinds with no model file are listed as missing, not guessed. Output: scenarios/moba/assets/packs/props.<sha256[:16]>.bin and an index entry in scenarios/moba/assets/packs/index.json. Cache key content-hashed from pack bytes. Naming uses prop from the start (a lane renames doodad to prop, row rename-doodad-to-prop). Work on the shared checkout on main (no clones, per the walk rule); publish with publish_on_origin. No public references: the OSPK format is this repo's own scripts/assets/build-packs.mjs (public search found 0 hits).

notes.note: Public search (github-search, 3 queries) found 0 hits for the OSPK pack format; the pack format is this repo's own build-packs.mjs. Plan: placed kinds come from map.osd doodad(...) lines (the loader's map file, manifest "map"); the model per kind from assets/doodads.json (loader source, play.js loadDoodadModels), the low variant from kind-low, footprint from doodad_sizes.json. Kinds whose type-to-kind mapping is inferred (docs/DOODAD_TYPES_688G.md, confidence low/medium) are packed by their model and flagged UNVERIFIED in the report. doodads-w3.tsv and doodad-types-w3.tsv are not in manifest.json tables and map.osd has no w3 placements, so the w3 kinds are reported as not placed.

BLOCKED (prop-pack-2). git-clone mode shallow of https://github.com/lanmower/oscraft failed 3 times (clone_failed, nothing kept) into /config/tmp/prop-pack-d1; GitHub info/refs answered 200 in ~8 s, so the pack transfer drops. Earlier: the stalled scratch copy /config/tmp/prop-pack (HEAD 6d8e7388, empty FETCH_HEAD, no shallow) was removed to re-clone shallow; git-clone then reported dest_exists on that path, so the clone went to prop-pack-d1. No build, no commit, no publish. Scratch-clone bash git is gate-denied (bash-git-bypass), so git-clone is the only clone route. Coordinator decision: one props pack plus its index.json entry, same conventions as build-packs.mjs, which gains hero-icon sprite atlases (64 px cells) from lane aeb61ebd595970cc8; rebase onto that commit and keep its changes; no separate icon output. Next: retry the shallow clone; read build-packs.mjs and index.json from origin main.

Premise check (prop-pack-2): origin main has scripts/assets/build-packs.mjs (5619 bytes, contents API ref=main). scenarios/moba/assets/packs/index.json is 404 on origin main, and no packs directory exists in the shared checkout or the scratch copy, so the index and packs are build outputs not committed; the next run must confirm the build writes them. The clone blocker stands: git-clone shallow failed 3 times, and the TLS handshake to api.github.com timed out again on a later read. The friction row git-clone-dest-exists-after-removal carries the dest_exists evidence.

BLOCKED again (prop-pack-2, second round). GitHub answers, but the transfer is too slow for a clone: codeload tarball measured 258081 bytes in 30 s (8.6 KB/s). Attempts this round: git-clone shallow x3 (clone_failed, nothing kept); gh repo clone lanmower/oscraft -- --depth 1 --branch main, one attempt, killed at its 900 s timeout with a 6.7 MB partial .git and no working tree. The repo is 381413 KB on the API, so a shallow clone is hours at this rate. Partial clone removed. Origin main facts (contents API, unchanged): scripts/assets/build-packs.mjs is 5619 bytes and writes OSPK packs named <stem>.<sha256[:16]>.bin plus index.json {schema:1, packs, entries} with absolute offsets; scenarios/moba/assets/packs/index.json is 404 on origin main, so it is a build output. Plan for the next run, unchanged: add a props stem to build-packs.mjs with the placed kinds from the moba map, one props.<sha256[:16]>.bin, rebase onto the hero-icon atlas commit (lane aeb61ebd595970cc8) when it lands, publish with publish_on_origin, read ci-status. Next run: retry the clone once the throughput is back, or with a fresh route.

Live index.json on the deployed site: 53 prop/ entries equal the entries computed from map.osd and props.json (0 mismatches); pack props.be22abac09a4e05e.bin 8911165 B (verify dispatch 1793542737432-5890-97d8e078f9ed5d2). Close commit c5bf6df7 on origin main.
material.witness_plan: Read-back check of every index entry against the pack bytes (dispatch id from a verify- session), then ci-status on the pushed sha.
